parts.description: WiFi 4 + BLE 5 module, ESP32-C3 RISC-V 160 MHz, 4 MB flash, PCB antenna
parts.notes: Antenna must sit at board edge with copper keepout under/around it per Espressif HW design guide. EN needs RC delay (10k pull-up + 1uF). GPIO2/8 must be high and GPIO9 high for SPI boot.

parts.description: WiFi 4 + BLE 5 module, dual-core ESP32-S3 240 MHz, 8 MB flash, PCB antenna
parts.notes: Strapping: GPIO0 (boot), GPIO3, GPIO45, GPIO46. Native USB on GPIO19 (D-) / GPIO20 (D+). EN RC delay required.

parts.description: WiFi 4 + BT Classic/BLE 4.2 module, dual-core ESP32 240 MHz, 4 MB flash, PCB antenna
parts.notes: No native USB: needs USB-UART bridge + auto-reset (EN/IO0) transistors for programming. GPIO34-39 are input-only without internal pulls. Strapping: IO0, IO2, IO5, IO12 (sets flash voltage - keep low), IO15.

parts.description: Compact WiFi 4 + BLE 5 module, ESP32-S3, 8 MB flash, PCB antenna
parts.notes: Same strapping and USB pins as ESP32-S3 (GPIO0/3/45/46; USB GPIO19/20). LGA module - check assembly capability.

parts.description: WiFi 6 + BLE 5 + 802.15.4 (Thread/Zigbee) module, ESP32-C6, 4 MB flash
parts.notes: Verify strapping pins and current figures against the current ESP32-C6-MINI-1 datasheet revision. USB on GPIO12 (D-) / GPIO13 (D+).

parts.description: BLE 5 module, Nordic nRF52832, 512 KB flash, chip antenna
parts.notes: Runs directly from a CR2032 (1.7-3.6 V). Program via SWD. Peak currents assume on-module DC/DC enabled. P0.21 is nRESET. NFC pins P0.09/P0.10 default to NFC until UICR is changed.

parts.description: BLE 5 / Thread / Zigbee module, Nordic nRF52840, 1 MB flash, native USB, chip antenna
parts.notes: VDDH input (2.5-5.5 V) allows direct Li-ion supply; VDD range 1.7-3.6 V. Verify current figures for the chosen TX power.

parts.description: Low-cost BLE module, Nordic nRF52832, PCB antenna
parts.notes: Vendor supply range quoted as 1.8-3.6 V. Verify pinout revision on the Ebyte datasheet before layout.

parts.description: Single-cell Li-ion/LiPo linear charger, 4.20 V, up to 500 mA, SOT-23-5
parts.notes: R_PROG 2k -> 500 mA, 10k -> 100 mA. 4.7 uF on VDD and VBAT. STAT can drive an LED to VDD/GND.

parts.description: 1.5 A single-cell Li-ion charger with power-path (dynamic power management), VQFN-16
parts.notes: Use when the load must run from USB while the battery charges. Exposed pad must be soldered to GND.

parts.description: Single-cell Li-ion fuel gauge (Impedance Track), I2C, integrated sense, SON-12
parts.notes: Needs a 10 mOhm sense resistor in the battery negative path. Configure design capacity over I2C.

parts.description: 3.3 V 600 mA LDO with enable, SOT-23-5
parts.notes: Dropout 250 mV at 600 mA: from a Li-ion cell, regulation is lost below ~3.55 V input at full load.

parts.description: 3.3 V 250 mA ultra-low-Iq (1.6 uA) LDO, SOT-23-3
parts.notes: 250 mA is not enough for WiFi TX peaks (~350 mA) - suitable for BLE/sensor loads only.

parts.description: 3.3 V 1 A LDO, SOT-223

parts.description: 5 V 1.5 A linear regulator, TO-220
parts.notes: From 12 V at 500 mA it dissipates 3.5 W: needs a heatsink. Prefer a buck converter above ~200 mA.

parts.description: 4.5-17 V input, 3 A synchronous buck converter, SOT-23-6 (TSOT)

parts.description: Fixed 5 V 3 A step-down regulator, up to 40 V input, TO-263-5

parts.description: 2-24 V input boost converter, 4 A switch, up to 28 V output, SOT-23-6
